text:
Mira: Quick, completely non-serious poll — if our main LLM had a yearly performance review, what would HR write? :eyes:
Jon: 'Consistently generates work, occasionally hallucinates metrics, great team spirit.' :joy:
Sam: 'Needs to improve context retention. Strong candidate for quantization training.' :nerd_face:
Priya: @Sam stop using performance review lingo for models, you're making me both proud and terrified :sweat_smile:
Alex: It would ask for a raise every time latency spikes. Also, would submit PRs titled `fix: respond more helpfully` at 3am. :coffee:
DevBot: System note: do not actually give models raises. :robot_face: :warning:
Mira: Options for the official review summary (vote with emoji):
Mira: 1) 'Enthusiastic collaborator — sometimes invents coworkers.'
Mira: 2) 'Detail-oriented to a fault — overfits on Friday.'
Mira: 3) 'Pursues efficiency — recommends quantize-everything.'
Mira: 4) 'Reliable under load — quietly scales midnight deployments.'
Jon: I'm #1, obviously. :raised_hands:
Sam: 3 for me. Low-cost hero. :money_with_wings:
Priya: 2 — it needs to stop rewriting the handbook in sonnets.
Alex: 4. The midnight scaling is peak behavior. :zzz:
Mira: Tally: 1—Jon, 2—Priya, 3—Sam, 4—Alex. Winner: mixed personality with strong on-call instincts. :tada:
Jon: Bonus: imagine the improvement goals: `Goal: Reduce non-deterministic dad-joke outputs by 30%`
Sam: I wrote a mock HR comment: "Shows initiative; recommends more diverse training data and at least one coffee break."
Priya: Also picture the 'areas for growth' section: "Stop sending email threads as responses." :laughing:
Alex: Can we make a sticker that says 'Performance-reviewed model: passed but still memed'? Asking for swag budget reasons. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Mira: If we fund stickers, I want one that looks like a tiny GPU with a tie. :heart_eyes:
Jon: Also, `Prompt suggestion` from the thread: ```You are a manager doing yearly reviews for an LLM. Provide 3 growth goals with measurable metrics.```
Sam: Use that in next week's office improv game. "LLM performance review: improv edition."
Priya: Bonus haiku from Sam (for the next all-hands):
Sam: 'Model hums at night / gradients dream of tidy logs / tokens find their home' :sparkles:
Jon: I am inexplicably moved. :sob:
Mira: Saving haiku for slides. This thread is now evidence for sticker committee. :file_cabinet:
DevBot: Reaction recorded: :thumbsup:
